machine: Shaft-mounted helical-bevel gearmotor SEW-EURODRIVE KA..T (hollow shaft, torque arm), 4-pole IEC motor on the input flange. Drive of the chain conveyors U13-TCS-320 (galleries, bridges) and of the belt conveyors U13-TL-50K (tunnels).

sprocket_rpm.src: Skandia KTIF p.2 table, column 30/33 100 t/h: speed 47-50 rpm, chain 0.63-0.67 m/s, sprocket 8 teeth, pitch 100 mm
sprocket_rpm.note: Same capacity (100 t/h), same chain pitch (100 mm) as the TCS-320; the TCS sprocket is NOT_FOUND. 8 teeth x 100 mm gives a pitch diameter 261 mm, 0.65 m/s -> 47.5 rpm.

torque_nm.src: T = 9550 P / n with n = 48 rpm
torque_nm.note: Output torque at the sprocket shaft for the three motor ratings in SITE.json (T7..T15).

why_ka97.src: SEW PDF p.145-146 (printed 144-145): 20 HP (15 kW) DV160L4 rows use K87 up to i = 79.34 (47 rpm, 22100 lb-in = 2497 Nm) and K97 from i = 86.52; 25 HP (18.5 kW) DV180M4 rows use K87 up to i = 63.00 (59 rpm) and K97 from i = 70.54 (53 rpm, 24300 lb-in = 2745 Nm)
why_ka97.note: At ~48 rpm the catalogue already moves 15 and 18.5 kW to K97; K87 tops out near 2500-2600 Nm in these rows, below the 2980-3680 Nm needed. One size for 11-18.5 kW (brief): KA97. For 11 kW KA87 would do; KA97 is kept for one spare-parts size.

why_ka67.src: SEW PDF p.142 (printed 141): 7.5 HP (5.5 kW) DV132S4 rows start with K67 at i = 7.28 and move to K77 only at i = 73.99 (51 rpm)
why_ka67.note: Tunnel belt conveyor U13-TL-50K, 5.5 kW (SITE.json T9, T13, T16), belt 2.4 m/s on the EST 400 mm pulley -> 115 rpm, 457 Nm. Outside the brief's 11-18.5 kW range; a KA97 on a 5.5 kW belt drive would be a wrong picture, so the second row comes from the same pages.

side.v: walkway side of the head (drive) section, on the head sprocket shaft
side.src: Cimbria RM p.1 'Gearmotor mounted on right or left hand side as specified', 'Parallel shaft helical gearmotor, hollow shaft'; Skandia KTIF p.1 'Direct-mounted gearbox motor with support frame', p.2 plan: drive on the side of the head section; lubnymash_equipment.md sec.2: shaft-mounted gearmotor on the side of the drive section
side.note: Side is free in the sources; the walkway side is the brief's choice (service access).

motor_direction.v: along the casing, toward the tail
motor_direction.note: Cimbria and Skandia use parallel-shaft units (motor parallel to the sprocket shaft, sticking out sideways). A KA bevel unit puts the motor at 90 deg to the shaft, so it lies along the casing; toward the tail keeps it off the tower / head end. NOT_FOUND in the sources for a KA.

torque_arm.v: tunnels: down, A-side (bushing on the casing side), clevis on the hood side under its bottom edge; galleries and bridges: up (unit upside down, B-side), clevis on the head box side over its top edge
torque_arm.src: SEW PDF p.274 A-side / B-side mounting; Skandia KTIF p.1-2 support frame under the drive
torque_arm.note: Up on the upper conveyors because down the clevis (0.41 m under the axis) hits the T3/T5 decks and the drop gate under every gallery head. The counter bracket (clevis, pad, bolts) is not in any source: EST.
